newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen steady.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.04 up at 41.53 to the dollar on Wednesday amid a high supply of the U.S. currency from abroad, dealers said.
They said the rupee might open steady on Thursday as the dollar had dropped to an attractive level.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, unchanged since June 28, was at 40.4600/40.6623 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed steady at 2.80 percent -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
